teaching_notes:
1. 【核心概念】：主谓一致就像是英语里的“双人舞”——主语是领舞，谓语动词是跟舞者。主语是单数，谓语就用单数（如 holds/is/has）；主语是复数，谓语就用复数（如 hold/are/have）。两者步调一致，句子才协调！
2. 【公式与口诀】：
   ① 语法一致：单对单，复对复（He walks / They walk）。
   ② 就近原则：Neither...nor / Either...or / Not only...but also 选近邻。
   ③ 意义一致：a number of（许多）带复数，the number of（数量）带单数；时间/金钱/距离整体看作单数。
3. 【避坑指南】：
   ① 忽视介词短语干扰：*The boy with two dogs is (不是 are) running.*（主语是 The boy，介词短语 with two dogs 是修饰成分）。
   ② 混淆复合不定代词：Everyone / Something / Each 做主语时，谓语动词一律用单数！
4. 【经典例句】：
   ① Either you or Tom **is** going to clean the room.（要么你要么汤姆去打扫房间。）
   ② The number of students in our school **is** growing.（我们学校的学生数量正在增加。）
   ③ Ten kilometres **is** a long distance to walk.（十公里是一段很长的步行距离。）

questions.question: My brother _____ to school every day.
questions.explanation: 主语 My brother 是第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词需用单数形式 walks。

questions.question: There _____ some orange juice in the bottle.
questions.explanation: orange juice 是不可数名词，There be 句型中谓语动词用单数 is。

questions.question: Tom and Jerry _____ good friends.
questions.explanation: Tom and Jerry 由 and 连接构成复数主语，谓语动词用复数 are。

questions.question: Every student in our class _____ a school uniform.
questions.explanation: Every修饰单数名词 student 做主语时，谓语动词用单数 has。

questions.question: The news on TV _____ very exciting today.
questions.explanation: news（新闻）是不可数名词，谓语动词用单数 is。

questions.question: She _____ like playing basketball after class.
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，否定句借助于助动词 doesn't。

questions.question: Maths _____ my favorite subject at school.
questions.explanation: Maths 形复实单，表示学科名称，谓语动词用单数 is。

questions.question: A girl with two dogs _____ running in the park.
questions.explanation: 句子真实主语是 A girl（单数），with two dogs 为介词短语修饰主语，谓语用 is。

questions.question: Neither Mike nor his classmates _____ at school yesterday.
questions.explanation: Neither...nor... 遵循就近原则，离动词最近的主语是 his classmates（复数），结合 yesterday 选 were。

questions.question: My little sister _____ drawing pictures very much.
questions.explanation: My little sister 为第三人称单数主语，一般现在时动词用 likes。

questions.question: Bread and butter _____ his regular breakfast.
questions.explanation: Bread and butter 指“黄油面包”这一整体食物概念，视为单数，谓语用 is。

questions.question: Both of my parents _____ English teachers.
questions.explanation: Both of... 表示“两者都”，作主语时谓语动词用复数 are。

questions.question: One of the boys _____ absent from class yesterday morning.
questions.explanation: One of + 复数名词 结构做主语，核心主语是 One（单数），结合 yesterday morning 选 was。

questions.question: There _____ a pen and three books on the table.
questions.explanation: There be 句型遵循“就近原则”，最靠近 be 动词的是单数名词 a pen，因此用 is。

questions.question: Each boy and each girl _____ a gift on Children's Day.
questions.explanation: Each... and each... 连接单数名词作主语时，谓语动词仍用单数形式 gets。

questions.question: Not only the students but also the teacher _____ looking forward to the field trip.
questions.explanation: Not only... but also... 遵循就近原则，邻近主语 the teacher 为单数，谓语动词选 is。

questions.question: A number of students _____ absent, but the number of students in our class _____ still 40.
questions.explanation: a number of 指“许多”，后接复数谓语 are；the number of 指“……的数量”，做主语谓语用单数 is。

questions.question: Three-fourths of the information _____ verified by the research team last night.
questions.explanation: 分数/百分数 + of + 名词 作主语，谓语动词取决于 of 后的名词。information 为不可数名词，结合 last night 选 was。

questions.question: My family _____ all big fans of football; we often watch matches together.
questions.explanation: family 属于集合名词，此处强调“家庭各个成员”，表示复数概念，谓语动词用 are。

questions.question: The famous writer and singer _____ going to give a speech at our school hall tomorrow.
questions.explanation: The famous writer and singer 只有一个冠词 The，指“同一个人既是作家又是歌手”，谓语动词用单数 is。

questions.question: He is one of the students who _____ selected for the national math Olympiad.
questions.explanation: 在“one of + 复数名词 + 定语从句”中，关系代词 who 指代复数名词 students，从句谓语动词用复数 have been。

questions.question: He is the only one of the students who _____ full marks in the physics contest.
questions.explanation: 在“the only one of + 复数名词 + 定语从句”中，强调“唯一的那一个”，从句谓语动词用单数 has got。

questions.question: Fifty dollars _____ too high a price for such a simple plastic toy.
questions.explanation: 表示金钱、时间、距离等的复数名词短语作主语，通常看作一个整体，谓语动词用单数 is。

questions.question: More than one student _____ failed the chemistry exam this term.
questions.explanation: More than one + 单数名词 结构作主语，谓语动词遵循语法一致用单数 has。

questions.question: Neither the project manager nor the software developers _____ satisfied with the new update.
questions.explanation: Neither...nor... 遵循就近原则，靠近谓语的是复数名词 developers，故选用复数 were。

questions.question: Between the two tall mountains _____ a quiet and peaceful ancient village.
questions.explanation: 倒装句型：介词短语置于句首，主语为后面的 a quiet and peaceful ancient village（单数），谓语动词用单数 lies。

questions.question: The committee _____ divided in their opinions regarding the proposed policy change.
questions.explanation: committee 整体为集合名词，此处由其后物主代词 their 提示，表示委员会内部各个成员意见分歧（复数概念），谓语用 are。

questions.question: Taking regular physical exercise and eating balanced meals _____ crucial for health.
questions.explanation: 两个动名词短语由 and 连接，表示两件独立的事情，主语为复数概念，谓语用 are。

questions.question: Not the doctor but the nurses _____ to blame for the tragic medical mistake.
questions.explanation: Not...but...（不是……而是……）遵循就近原则，靠近谓语的主语是 the nurses（复数），谓语用 are。

questions.question: What the school management urgently needs _____ more qualified English teachers.
questions.explanation: What 引导的主语从句，若表语为复数名词（more qualified English teachers），谓语动词通常用复数 are。
